news_intelligence.title: ACC Q2 profit slumps 91% to ₹93 crore, revenue slips 5.2% to ₹5,656 crore
news_intelligence.summary:
ACC Ltd, an Adani Group cement firm, on Tuesday reported 91.7 per cent fall in consolidated net profit to Rs 93 crore for September quarter FY27, on account of decline in sales volume due to a Master Supply Agreement with the parent entity. The company had posted a profit of Rs 1,119 crore in the July-September period, according to a regulatory filing from ACC, a subsidiary of Ambuja Cements. The year-ago profit "includes income tax provision reversal of Rs 659 crore relating to earlier period and interest on income tax refund of Rs 205 crore." Revenue from operations was down 5.24 per cent year-on-year to Rs 5,656 crore in September quarter FY27. Total expenses were up 2.46 per cent at Rs 5,602 crore. In the quarter, revenue from the cement business was down 6.9 per cent at Rs 5,206 crore.
